title: Google Play Reviews Scraper
description: Google Play Reviews Scraper collects structured data from Scrappa's /google/play/product/reviews endpoint. Submit multiple inputs in one Actor run and receive one dataset item per result. Submit multiple batch entries in one run.

product_ids.title: Product Ids
product_ids.description: Batch input entries. Each id is sent as the id value.

product_id.title: Product ID
product_id.description: Google Play product id. For apps this is the package name.

url.title: URL
url.description: Google Play URL of the item. Alternative to supplying the product identifier.

gl.title: GL
gl.description: Country code for the storefront (2 letters, e.g. us, de).

store.title: Store
store.description: Google Play store vertical: apps, movies, tv, books, or audiobooks.

season_id.title: Season ID
season_id.description: TV season id for Google Play TV products.

all_reviews.title: All Reviews
all_reviews.description: Request Google Play review-expanded product pages when available.

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: Review platform filter, such as phone, tablet, tv, chromebook, watch, or car.

sort_by.title: Sort By
sort_by.description: Review sort mode, such as 1, 2, 3, most_relevant, newest, or rating.

num.title: NUM
num.description: Requested review result count for clients that need SerpApi-compatible parameters.

next_page_token.title: Next Page Token
next_page_token.description: Review pagination token for clients that need SerpApi-compatible parameters.
